messages.subject: "diffCpGann" & cpG info extraction
parts:
Hi all,
I am using methylkit to do some differential methylation analysis.  The instructions are really clear on how to create a gene annotation object(Diiffann) and extraction these gene names with Association WithTSS().  However, i am trying to do thing to extraction gene annotation over CpG island instead of  individual bases like we get with the "Diffann" object and I am having a hard time printing the file that can show this information.  Here is my code:

diffCpGann=annotateWithFeature(as(myDiff25p,"GRanges"),
                                    cpg.obj$CpGi,cpg.obj$shores,
                         feature.name="CpGi",flank.name="shore")

AssociationWithTSS = getAssociationWithTSS(diffCpGann)
write.table(AssociationWithTSS, "CpGAnnotation.xls", quote=FALSE, sep="\t", col.names = NA)

It looks like getAssociationWithTSS() doesn't work for diffCpGann obgect like it does for the Diffann object.  Also I tried to use the get.Flanks() that wouldn't work either.  Does anyone have any ideas on how to extract gene  annotation over CpG island with methylkit?  Thanks.

Roxy

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: "diffCpGann" & cpG info extraction
parts: There is no direct function to do that, are you trying to associate CpG islands to genes? You can then simply use GenomicRanges package functions to do overlaps between CpGs islands and promoters of genes. please check GenomicRanges vignette, providing help with that is out of scope for this forum. In general, all methylKit objects can be converted to GRanges objects, and you can use all the functionality in GenomicRanges package.
